items.title: Tyrone Tracy: Move to IR official
items.body_text:
The Giants placed Tracy (hamstring) on injured reserve Tuesday, Dan Salomone of the team's official site reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: DeForest Buckner: Headed back to San Francisco
items.body_text:
The 49ers acquired Buckner from the Colts on Tuesday in exchange for a 2027 fourth-round draft pick, Tom Pelissero of Netflix reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Lamar Jackson: Trending toward return in Week 8
items.body_text:
Jackson (ankle) is "believed to be close to 100 percent" and is expected to play Sunday versus the Bills, Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.
